author: Kavya
text:
Hey guys, just a small lesson on how to trade candle PA!

Infact, candlesticks are great to find out the Kinks. But which candle we should look for?

I personally like to look for Swing High Candle or Swing Low Candle. Break of Swing High candle is like breaking some kind of RS in LTF which might exist on left. But if CAPS forms near SHC (Swing High Candle) or SLC (Swing Low Candle) that is even great as it is FTB to MPL!

But if we have LS below or nearby to SHC (or SLC) then the low of that candle again becomes important RS Flip. But if there is QM on LS with just 2 candles then that QM is also need to pay attention.

Yes, MPL’s are great placed to trade for FO when they are just near to Kink or what my friend Sali named ORFL.

If you look for every candle, it means less but when you look for SHC and SLC along with PA and Kink it will definitely help you out to take to the pip entries!

What inspired me to look for candle PA?

RTM’s old article which is now locked kept ditching my mind every time that IF started candle PA means there must be something there to look for candle. But then many time I lost looking for old terms all over internet. But then suddenly I got surprised when I was looking for engulf of candle. Then I got my eureka moment and sharp bounce to next level of trading.

Thanks to my curiosity to take me to RTM, and thanks to all Masters and specially IF for educating peoples for free and giving me 2nd chance!
